title: Tiered Reservoir Blockpool with Soft-Pin Fastpath and Heterogeneous Reuse
author: Ravi Desai
description:
Motivation: The existing paged KV block manager performs well for uniform block sizes but shows tail latency variance and allocation churn for mixed-size workloads (short prompt-heavy vs. long-context streaming). This PR introduces a tiered reservoir allocator that separates small/medium/large block pools, a fastpath soft-pin mechanism for hot prefixes, and a heterogeneous reuse policy that prefers same-size reuse but can gracefully coalesce when fragmentation is high.

Design summary: A lightweight reservation layer classifies block requests into three tiers (4KB, 32KB, 256KB logical slots) with per-tier free rings and a reservoir of muted reservations that can be loaned across tiers under pressure. Soft-pin is implemented as a per-request hint that keeps recently-used slots on a fast reuse queue for N subsequent allocations; the queue is lockless for the common case and falls back to a per-shard slow path. The heterogenous reuse policy introduces an LRU-weighted scoring function that balances locality (reuse same-size blocks) and compaction pressure (allow coalescing of adjacent free slots into larger logical blocks). Kernel/hint guidance: allocator exposes optional CPU hints so the runtime can prefer GPU-friendly pin candidates during token-level KV cache warmups.

Testing and validation: Unit tests cover reservation handoff, soft-pin expiry, and coalescing invariants. Integration tests run against the runtime harness with continuous batching enabled; we added a soak test (10k mixed-size requests over 4 hours) and crash-injection to verify no deadlocks. Benchmarks were run on a c5n-like machine and a dedicated inference box with A100s to compare tail-latency, P50/P95, and allocation stalls.

Migration notes: New config flags added under runtime.blockpool.*. Defaults retain previous behavior (fallback reservoir disabled), rollout gated behind experiment flag `blockpool.tiered_reservoir=true` for first 10% of traffic. Admins can tune per-tenant tier thresholds and soft-pin window via Redwood Console.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4532)
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] Benchmarks + regression alerts
- [x] Config flags + rollout plan

Related: ENG-4532 (tiered-reservoir design), ENG-4680 (kv-cache warmup kernels), SUP-1204 (customer incident that motivated reuse), RFC-2025 (allocation hint API).
commits_summary: initial tiered-reservoir allocator implementation and API surface
add soft-pin fastpath: lockless hot-queue + fallback path
heterogeneous reuse: scoring-based coalescer and stress tests
expose kernel hints for runtime routing and warmups
integration tests and soak harness updates
addressed reviewer feedback and tightened invariants
docs: runtime config, rollout steps, console knobs
review_comments: Asha Patel: Gate the rollout behind an experiment flag (done) and ensure default config preserves prior behavior (author: added experiments/flags.yaml and defaults).
Miguel Rivera: Concern about lockless queue ABA; ask for epoch stamps on entries (author: added 64-bit epoch tags and unit tests to prevent ABA).

Sofia Chen: Observe P95 improvement but saw small regression in long streaming requests at low QPS; suggestion to make cross-tier loans bounded per-shard (author: implemented per-shard loan caps and added regression test).
Ben Thompson: Requested clearer console knobs and a migration doc for Dedicated customers (author: added console/recipes/blockpool-rollout.md and docs/runtime/blockpool.md).
Author response: Addressed all requests, added more unit coverage for coalescer invariants, and re-ran benchmarks after fixes.
release_notes: Introduce a tiered reservoir blockpool allocator with soft-pin fastpath and heterogeneous reuse policy. Improves tail latency and reduces allocation churn for mixed-size KV cache workloads; rollout is experiment-gated. Admin knobs available in Console.
benchmark_summary: P50: -4% (allocation stalls reduced), P95: -18% (tail latency improvement for mixed workloads), mean allocation latency: -22%, memory fragmentation ratio: -12% with default config. Soak test: no allocator-related crashes over 4 hours at 10k mixed requests.
migration_notes: No automatic data migration required. New flags: runtime.blockpool.tiered_reservoir (bool), runtime.blockpool.soft_pin_window_ms (int), runtime.blockpool.tier_thresholds (comma separated sizes). Default: tiered_reservoir=false to preserve current behavior. Enable behind canary before wider rollout.
notes_for_oncall: If allocation stalls appear after rollout, disable experiment flag 'blockpool.tiered_reservoir' to revert to legacy allocator. Check metrics: blockpool.alloc_stalls, blockpool.cross_tier_loans, blockpool.softpin_evictions. If soft-pin queue shows high churn, reduce soft_pin_window_ms.
risk_assessment: medium: introduces allocator path changes but gated behind experiment. Thorough tests and soak harness reduced risk. Monitor fragmentation and cross-tier loans metrics during rollout.
